lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Approximately five horizontal rows of high-luminance, roughly circular pixel clusters arranged in a grid-like configuration across the mid-lateral flank posterior to the branchial region.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Subtle vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity that intersect with the horizontal rows of spots, forming a coordinate-like lattice structure.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Two prominent horizontal ridges are visible on the upper third of the flank, characterized by a sharp luminance gradient transition from high intensity (dorsal) to shadow (ventral).

other_distinctive_markers: The visible pectoral fin displays a high-density population of smaller, irregularly spaced high-luminance points distinct from the larger, grid-aligned blobs on the lateral flank.
